skill.name: module-scaffolder
skill.description: Scaffolds DevPrep AI feature modules with TypeScript components, types, barrel exports, path aliases, and architecture checks.
skill.summary: Create and validate DevPrep AI feature modules from reusable templates.
skill.author: ArieGoldkin

security_audit.summary: All 76 static findings are false positives caused by imports, documentation formatting, or fixed and quoted shell operations. However, the add and validate scripts accept an unvalidated module name, allowing parent path segments to escape the intended modules directory. Publication should wait until both scripts enforce name validation and path containment.

remediation.issue: add-component.sh and validate-module.sh build filesystem paths from an unvalidated module name.
remediation.suggestion: Apply the create script's module-name regex in both scripts, canonicalize MODULE_PATH, and reject any resolved path outside MODULES_DIR before reading or writing.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated module name permits directory escape
semantic_findings.description: The add and validate scripts place the module-name argument into MODULE_PATH without the strict check used by the create script. Parent path segments can escape frontend/src/modules, enabling out-of-scope component writes or recursive inspection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Direct data flow from positional arguments to filesystem paths is visible, while only create-module.sh applies a restrictive module-name regex.

content.value_statement: Creating consistent feature modules by hand is slow and error-prone. This skill generates DevPrep AI module structure, starter TypeScript files, components, and quality checks.
actual_capabilities: Creates a named module under frontend/src/modules with components, hooks, utils, and a types file.
Generates a starter React component and TypeScript types from bundled templates.
Adds a PascalCase component to an existing module and updates its barrel export.
Checks directory structure, barrel exports, file length, interface names, any types, and relative imports.
Provides reference guidance for architecture, naming, path aliases, and quality standards.
limitations: Assumes the skill is installed under .claude/skills and the project uses frontend/src/modules.
Current scripts do not generate hook or utility implementations from the bundled templates.
Validation uses text searches instead of the TypeScript compiler or an abstract syntax tree.
Module names for add and validate operations require trusted input until path containment is fixed.

prompt_templates.prompt: Review the planned notifications domain, choose compliant names, scaffold the module, add required components, and report validation warnings without changing unrelated files.

output: Created the analytics module with component, hook, utility, and type locations.
Generated AnalyticsCard and the components barrel export.
Reported the module path and recommended validation command.

output_examples.output: Created AnalyticsSummary in the analytics components directory and added its barrel export.
Reported structure, file-size, interface naming, any-type, and import checks with errors and warnings.

best_practices: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens for module names, with no path separators.
Review the resolved project and module paths before allowing generated files to be written.
Run validation after every scaffold operation, then run the project compiler, linter, and tests.
anti_patterns: Do not pass dots, slashes, absolute paths, or untrusted text as a module name.
Do not treat generated components as finished implementation without reviewing props, behavior, and accessibility.
Do not treat text-based validation as a replacement for TypeScript, linting, or automated tests.

faq.question: What does the create script generate?
faq.answer: It creates component, hook, and utility directories, a types file, a starter component, and barrel files.

faq.question: Which project layout is required?
faq.answer: The scripts expect a frontend/src/modules directory four levels above the skill scripts.

faq.question: Can it generate hooks and utilities?
faq.answer: Bundled templates exist, but current scripts do not create hook or utility implementations. Add them manually or extend the scripts.

faq.question: Will it overwrite an existing component?
faq.answer: The component script stops when the target component file already exists. Review barrel export changes before running it.

faq.question: What does validation cover?
faq.answer: It checks expected directories, barrel exports, file length, interface prefixes, any types, and relative import counts.

faq.question: Which AI coding tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
